reason: 该插件的核心面向是为 DSH 智能体提供跨会话记忆：记录问题与多方案解决记录、可检索查询并回写执行结果与状态，README 中明确列出的工具集为 selfmem_search、selfmem_record、selfmem_hit/selfmem_fail、selfmem_import 与 selfmem_status，共同表明其主要用途是记忆与上下文增强而非执行外部服务调用。

summaries.zh: DSH 插件用于跨会话记录问题与解决方案，支持前提感知检索、执行反馈回写与外部导入，帮助智能体复用既有经验。
summaries.en: DSH plugin stores problems and solutions across sessions, supports context-aware retrieval, hit/fail feedback updates, and import, so agents can reuse prior experience.

capabilities: Persist cross-session problem/solution records in local JSON storage
Provide context-aware search and ranking for stored records
Allow updating solution state (hit/fail) after execution
Import memory records from file or inline JSON/text

reasons.code: The plugin stores data in a local records file path and performs read/write operations for lifecycle management.
State mutation is performed through explicit commands such as selfmem_record and selfmem_hit/selfmem_fail.
The import command accepts external sources (file/JSON/text), creating additional data integrity and content-trust considerations.
